test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa5961821430616990d36c9b5d1b1a6bfd51576430f062ee9f9a90c34c010e5b.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately first row element, second and third elements from second row and third row element shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately first and fourth element from second row shifts in the anti-clockwise direction. 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be2a1ff7e1a8e87e75efc977db57d91e2cc9e6f2e286b6423045f8fd9718191e.png] ​

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately first row and third row elements shifts in the clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately first and third element from second row elements shifts in the clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately third and fourth element from second row elements shifts in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e3ebe70bd20b9fbdc9b9898657dfcd4fa2b806aeef0107fe13cb2c52b5404f1.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30f77e9b9445dea561c71030be6120aacbbce5d910b16dd1d9466a270ac74298.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (4)’ is the correct answer.
